svg.title: Fractional part of 16/d for 1 ≤ d ≤ 16
svg.desc: An example with R = 4. Each blue branch decreases from an excluded value of one to zero. Separate branches are not connected across jumps at d = 16/m. Gold dots mark values at integer d. Open circles at height one are excluded endpoints.

g.text: Open circles are excluded endpoints; the fractional part never equals 1.
